title: swm-20220425
主要内容: On April 21, 2022, the Company held its 2022 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, where several proposals were considered and acted upon. Proposal One involved the election of directors, with Deborah Borg, Jeffrey Kramer, and Anderson D. Warlick elected to serve until the 2024 Annual Meeting. Proposal Two concerned the ratification of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm for 2022. Proposal Three was a non-binding advisory vote to approve executive compensation, with shareholders voting in favor.
